```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent1 "<!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "Expanded Entity Text">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  %ent1;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Comment containing special chars: <>&"' -->
  <ns2:child id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section with embedded tags <child> &ent2; </child>
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&ent2;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA | sub)*>
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY internal 'Parameter Entity Value'>">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY reference "Parsed Entity Reference">
  <?target-pi data="test-value"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="urn:doc:base" xmlns:xml="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace">
  <!-- Top level comment block 1 -->
  <section xml:id="sec1">
    <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="print.css"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested comment-like syntax inside CDATA -->
      <sub xmlns:ext="urn:ext">Extended data &reference; &internal;</sub>
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, author)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent.auth "John Doe">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-ext "<!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-ext;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY sample-pdf SYSTEM "sample.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-model href="catalog.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment preceding books -->
  <book xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="sample.pdf">
    <title>
      <![CDATA[Book Title with <Tags> & Entities &ent.auth;]]>
    </title>
    <author>&ent.auth;</author>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="ISO-8859-1"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item.default "Default Item Name">
  <!ENTITY % macro.attr "id ID #REQUIRED">
  <!ATTLIST item %macro.attr;>
  <?inventory-processor mode="strict"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://www.example.com/inv" xmlns:loc="http://www.example.com/loc">
  <!-- Comment: Inventory listing follows -->
  <loc:warehouse name="Main">
    <item id="i1">
      <![CDATA[
        Item description block 1: <item>&item.default;</item>
      ]]>
    </item>
    <item id="i2">&item.default;</item>
  </loc:warehouse>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE notes [
  <!ELEMENT notes (note*)>
  <!ELEMENT note (heading, body)>
  <!ELEMENT heading (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY urgent "URGENT WARNING">
  <!ENTITY % body-decl "<!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>">
  %body-decl;
  <?note-system debug="on"?>
]>
<notes xmlns="http://xml.ns.org/notes" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Important notes section -->
  <note>
    <heading>&urgent;</heading>
    <body>
      <![CDATA[
        <html:div>HTML styled block inside CDATA with &urgent;</html:div>
      ]]>
    </body>
  </note>
</notes>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE application [
  <!ELEMENT application (module*)>
  <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY mod.name "CoreModule">
  <!ENTITY % ext-defs "
    <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY ext.ref 'ExtendedReference'>
  ">
  %ext-defs;
  <!NOTATION exe SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY binary SYSTEM "app.exe" NDATA exe>
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose"?>
<application xmlns="http://ns.example.net/app" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Application configuration module -->
  <module>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw configuration: <setting name="debug">true</setting>
    ]]>
  </module>
  <module>&mod.name; and &ext.ref;</module>
</application>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (data)*>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY api.token "TOKEN-XYZ-123">
  <!ENTITY % entity.set "<!ENTITY api.url 'https://api.example.com'>">
  %entity.set;
  <?api-logger destination="syslog"?>
]>
<response xmlns="http://api.example.com/schema" xmlns:soap="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/">
  <!-- Response wrapper comment -->
  <soap:Body>
    <data>
      <![CDATA[
        Payload response data: API URL is &api.url; with token &api.token;
      ]]>
    </data>
    <data>&api.token;</data>
  </soap:Body>
</response>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY rec.prefix "REC-">
  <!ENTITY % rec.ent "<!ENTITY rec.suffix "-END">">
  %rec.ent;
  <?archive-meta author="admin" date="2023-10-01"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://www.example.org/archive" xmlns:meta="http://www.example.org/archive/meta">
  <!-- Archive records follow -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      Metadata header with CDATA & records specification.
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <record>&rec.prefix;001&rec.suffix;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE html-doc [
  <!ELEMENT html-doc (head, body)>
  <!ELEMENT head (title)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright 2023">
  <!ENTITY % attrs "id ID #IMPLIED">
  <!ATTLIST body %attrs;>
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="default.css"?>
]>
<html-doc xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Document head and body wrapper -->
  <head>
    <title>Test Page</title>
  </head>
  <body id="b1">
    <![CDATA[
      <svg:svg width="100" height="100">
        <svg:circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40"/>
      </svg:svg>
    ]]>
    ©right;
  </body>
</html>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (property*)>
  <!ELEMENT property (name, value)>
  <!ELEMENT name (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT value (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY prop.val "DynamicValue">
  <!ENTITY % dtd.macro "<!ENTITY prop.val.ext 'ExtendedDynamicValue'>">
  %dtd.macro;
  <!NOTATION conf SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "README.txt" NDATA conf>
]>
<?config-processing mode="auto"?>
<configuration xmlns="http://example.com/config" xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns">
  <!-- Configuration property list -->
  <property>
    <name>Param1</name>
    <value>
      <![CDATA[
        Raw property value with <markup> and entity &prop.val; &prop.val.ext;
      ]]>
    </value>
  </property>
  <property>
    <name>Param2</name>
    <value>&prop.val.ext;</value>
  </property>
</configuration>
```
